# Ultimate ASI Loader

Source: https://github.com/ThirteenAG/Ultimate-ASI-Loader

Version: 9.7.4. The official x64 release archive contains `dinput8.dll`, distributed without binary modifications as `winhttp.dll` in the optional loader package. Download URL and both SHA-256 checksums are pinned in `tools/loader.json`, matching the PlayerObstructionHoldFire packaging setup. The MIT license from this upstream tag is included here and in the bundled ZIP.
